claims.evidence: One source per (cell line x time point x biological replicate x SILAC channel x workflow arm). setup.txt gives each MS sample its line, replicate and day; summary.txt assigns runs 01-24 to experiments Sample01-24 (Fraction 1) and runs 25-3, 26-48 to the SAME experiments Sample01-24 (Fraction 11), i.e. each SILAC mixture was measured once as total proteome and once after phospho enrichment. The proteome and phospho-enriched rows of one mixture are aliquots of the same lysate; they get separate source names because characteristics[enrichment process] differs (precedent annotations/PXD002425, PXD010683). DMSO in the light source names is the vehicle stated by the deposit.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + characteristics[dose] + factor value[treatment] rows 1-96
claims.value: SILAC light = untreated (DMSO vehicle), dose not applicable; SILAC heavy = dasatinib, 1 uM
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and paper Methods: "GSCs containing 'heavy' amino acids were treated with 1uM Dasatinib and 'light' GSCs with DMSO vehicle control"; dataProcessingProtocol: "The output provided is a heavy/light ratio i. e. Dasatinib treated/control". summary.txt Multiplicity 2, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8. Data check (datacheck.txt, median log2 normalized H/L): RB1 S807 -3.2/-2.8/-2.8 (NCH711d/NCH705/NCH421k), RB1 S811 -2.3/-2.5, RB1 S780 -0.4..-0.8 in all lines (loss of pRB in the heavy = dasatinib channel, consistent with antiproliferative drug); RB1 T373 -0.77 in NCH711d (MES) vs ~0 in PN lines and CDK1 T161 lower in MES than PN, matching the paper statement that CDK1-T161 and RB1-T373 are downregulated by dasatinib in MES but not PN GSCs. Controls written untreated per campaign rule 4.

claims.evidence: summary.txt (all 48 runs): Variable modifications "Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term);Phospho (STY)", Multi modifications empty, Labels1 "Arg10;Lys8"; parameters.txt Fixed modifications "Carbamidomethyl (C)". One search for all runs, so all rows share the parameters. Arg10 = +10.008 (UNIMOD:267), Lys8 = +8.014 (UNIMOD:259); label mods written MT=Variable per campaign rule 11.

CONFLICT: paper Methods say "DMEM:F12 with Arg-10 and Lys-6"; PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol and the MaxQuant search say Arg10;Lys8. Data: with Lys8 searched, 83-97% of K-only (no R) peptide evidences per run carry an H/L ratio (evstats.txt, e.g. run 01 10,364/10,873), which would not happen if lysine carried +6 Da. Deposit + data win; the paper statement is recorded as an error.
PRIDE: "overnight digestion with Trypsin". MaxQuant search rule Trypsin/P, specific, max 2 missed cleavages (campaign rule 2: digestion enzyme recorded).

limitations: Phospho-enrichment method (rows 49-96) is not described in PRIDE or the paper; enrichment inferred from per-run phospho evidence fractions (40-80%) and summary.txt experiment/fraction mapping.
Paper says Lys-6 while PRIDE and the MaxQuant search say Lys8; annotated Lys8 (UNIMOD:259) on deposit + data evidence.

Deposited mqpar.xml is from an earlier search configuration (49 files incl. undeposited qecf1-OA0015-25.raw and -25-2.raw, experiments Sample01-48, no fractions); summary.txt/parameters.txt describe the final search and were used for the file->experiment map; the precursor tolerance (4.5 ppm) comes from that mqpar.xml (parameters.txt does not print it).

NCH711d and NCH705 have no Cellosaurus/CLO/BTO/EFO entry: cellosaurus accession/name, age, sex, ancestry and developmental stage are not available; sdrf-tools check reports all four cell line names as not found in ontologies.
